project.name: ci-diagnosis-mcp
project.objective: Build a Python MCP server (mcp SDK 2.x, stdio) that diagnoses failed GitHub Actions runs for coding agents: it collects log and metadata evidence, keeps a mode and origin belief, ranks the next evidence to gather, and returns structured, agent-native diagnoses as specified in DESIGN.md v2.

assumptions.text: The repository owner (Shrikant Pawade) is the only human approver; approvals are recorded from explicit chat statements quoting the owner's words.

decisions.title: Language and SDK: Python with mcp 2.x
decisions.text: Server is Python using the official mcp SDK 2.x (MCPServer, formerly FastMCP) over stdio. Chosen because the maintainer reads Python, not TypeScript; the SDK is official and installable with uvx/pip. TypeScript scaffold from the first attempt was discarded.

decisions.title: Belief is two variables: mode and origin
decisions.text: A single root-cause label mixed what failed with why. Mode (what the log shows) is set by parsers with decisive weights; origin (this_change, pre_existing, flaky, environment, external) is a Bayesian posterior fed by diff, history, matrix, attempts and rerun channels. Adopted after an independent design review found overlapping hypotheses, under-confidence on easy cases, and double counting in the single-variable design.

decisions.title: No model call inside the server
decisions.text: The server does deterministic extraction and Bayesian updating only; the calling agent is the reasoner. Avoids a second model's cost, latency, API key, and non-determinism, and keeps the engine unit-testable.

decisions.title: GitHub Actions first, stdio only, no rerun side effect in v1
decisions.text: First provider is GitHub Actions; analysis layer stays provider-agnostic. Transport is stdio (local agents). rerun_job is excluded from v1 because it needs actions:write and agents already have gh run rerun; rerun results still enter as evidence via attempt linking.

decisions.title: Within-channel combination and tempering
decisions.text: Per channel: max of supporting weights times min of opposing weights per origin; channels multiply; tempering T from {0.5,0.7,1.0} chosen on the fixture corpus, default 0.7; no per-channel cap (nothing sums). Fixes the review finding that max-only silently discarded opposing evidence and that the cap was unreachable.

decisions.title: Process: Genesis with minimal human gates and model reviewers
decisions.text: Owner wants automation and a 2-3 hour build. Human approvals are limited to the two Genesis-mandated gates (spec, plan), each given once. Tasks are classified honestly; model reviews (Opus 5.5 for design, Sonnet 5.5 for code) are run in fresh contexts and recorded as decisions with reasons, not as blocking gates, except where Genesis auto-adds independent-review for medium risk, which the owner approves in one batch. Approver name: Shrikant Pawade. Builder: Fable 5.1 in this session; no ultracode fan-out because the parts are sequentially dependent.

decisions.title: Spec review (Opus 5.5): APPROVE_WITH_CHANGES; disposition of each item
decisions.text: Reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5, fresh context, read-only, given SPEC.md and DESIGN.md. Verdict APPROVE_WITH_CHANGES. Builder disposition: MUST_FIX 1 accepted: whole-log check always runs on pre-filtered lines; slice{window,mismatch} exposed; AC-3 asserts exact values; DESIGN s13/s19 aligned. MUST_FIX 2 accepted: attempts observations defined relative to the attempt under investigation with weights; run_attempt input added. MUST_FIX 3 accepted: availability rule with unavailable_actions[], observed means at least one observation, equivalence stop requires mode confidence not low and overrides the two-channel rule. MUST_FIX 4 accepted: required output keys bound in FR-17 and asserted by AC-6. MUST_FIX 5 accepted: ordered derivation rules, test-path globs, null label, mixed case in AC-8. MUST_FIX 6 accepted: excerpts fenced with longer backtick runs and labelled untrusted; lines capped at 2000 chars before matching; new AC-13. MUST_FIX 7 accepted: umask 077, dir 0700, repo regex, cache files by job id; new AC-14. MUST_FIX 8 accepted: Authorization only to the API host; AC-12 scans content, errors, stderr and cache; unprovable clause dropped. MUST_FIX 9 accepted: fixtures and expected.json committed before parser code as a separate task with a ledger trace; three adversarial unknown cases; unknown-rate definition fixed. MUST_FIX 10 accepted as cut: AC-4 replay moved out of v0.1; ranking formula unit-tested instead. MUST_FIX 11 accepted: mcp>=2,<3; NFR-7 says direct dependencies. SHOULD_FIX 1-9 all accepted (failed conclusions, startup_failure, repo-relative paths, 20 MB log_text cap, 410/in-progress/scope errors, cheap ACs for stdout purity, determinism, candidate_runs, token order, AC-7 content density, AC-11 redirect counting, smoothing pseudo-count 1, progress notifications, mode runner-up and step_context kept). CUT_IF_LATE applied now to protect the 2-3 hour budget: cut 1 (AC-4), cut 2 (add_evidence/retract_evidence removed from v0.1; agent can reason without them), cut 3 (level-2 extra-log downloads removed; level-1 signatures only), cut 4 (per-repo prior updates removed; outcomes stored, global prior used), cut 5 partially (gradle/maven, docker, cargo deferred; formatters kept because their regexes are trivial), cut 6 (rebuild-from-GitHub and AC-9 replaced by a not-found error), cut 7 (over-20 MB logs use a plain tail cap of 20000 lines). Reason for accepting cuts: reviewer and builder agree the parser list and GitHub-backed actions would not fit the budget; every cut is additive later and none touches FR-4 or the generic fallback, which guard the top risk.

knowledge.title: mcp SDK 2.x API facts
knowledge.text: mcp 2.3.0: FastMCP renamed to MCPServer (from mcp.server.mcpserver import MCPServer). @server.tool() auto-detects structured output from the return annotation. A tool may return mcp.types.CallToolResult directly with custom content plus structured_content; the SDK validates structured_content against the output model derived from the return annotation. run(transport='stdio'). Local venv resolved to Python 3.10, the declared minimum.
